description: AGSC-09-09 as stated on 2026-09-24: a positional argument a verb does not define is AGSC-E002 with exit 2, exactly like a flag outside the closed list. Derivation: export defines no positional (its outputs go under dist/export/, AGSC-01-26), build defines none, propose defines exactly one slug and mcp at most one path; every argument beyond that is a usage error of AGSC-09-08's exit-2 class, and nothing is written or printed on stdout. Before this date export --markdown ./out was accepted in silence and wrote to dist/export/markdown/ — the operator named a directory and nothing said it was ignored.
note: added 2026-09-24 at rc.6; expected values derived by hand from the rule text, not from a run of any engine
